conclusion: Sparse recovery to ~0.94 needs BOTH the cosine scorer (leg 2) AND current-slot inclusion (leg 3); the two interact. radix+width (legs 4-5) are selection-neutral (retired). head_agg (leg 1) is not a reference->production difference. fp8/bf16 (legs 6-7) are blocked (production raw-dot kernel only; no non-fix cosine route) and bounded second-order.
